# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison

## Overview
Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.

## Data Source

### water_supply_demand
Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.

### per_capita_freshwater
Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.

### groundwater_extraction
Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.

### precipitation_trends
Fields: `country` (string), `decade` (categorical: 1990s / 2000s / 2010s), `mean_precip_mm` (integer, mm/year; range 41–1,761). Three decadal averages per country (30 rows total).

## Data Notes

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    D = json.load(f)

# Order countries by supply_demand_ratio (most stressed first)
sd = sorted(D['water_supply_demand']['data'], key=lambda x: x['supply_demand_ratio'])
countries = [r['country'] for r in sd]
n = len(countries)

# Build lookup dicts
sd_ratio = {r['country']: r['supply_demand_ratio'] for r in sd}
stress_cls = {r['country']: r['stress_class'] for r in sd}
pc = {r['country']: r['per_capita_m3'] for r in D['per_capita_freshwater']['data']}
gw = {r['country']: r for r in D['groundwater_extraction']['data']}

# Precip trend: % change from 1990s to 2010s
precip_by = {}
for r in D['precipitation_trends']['data']:
    precip_by.setdefault(r['country'], {})[r['decade']] = r['mean_precip_mm']
precip_change = {c: (precip_by[c]['2010s'] - precip_by[c]['1990s']) / precip_by[c]['1990s'] * 100 for c in countries}

# Colors
BG = '#0d1117'
TEXT = '#c9d1d9'
GRID = '#21262d'
ACCENT_RED = '#f85149'
ACCENT_ORANGE = '#d29922'
ACCENT_YELLOW = '#e3b341'
ACCENT_GREEN = '#3fb950'
ACCENT_BLUE = '#58a6ff'

def stress_color(cls):
    return {'Extremely High': ACCENT_RED, 'High': ACCENT_ORANGE, 'Medium-High': ACCENT_YELLOW, 'Medium': ACCENT_BLUE, 'Low': ACCENT_GREEN}[cls]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 13), facecolor=BG)
fig.suptitle('Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison (2023)',
             color='white', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.97)
fig.text(0.5, 0.94, 'Countries ordered by water supply-to-demand ratio (most stressed → least stressed)',
         ha='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=11, fontstyle='italic')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 3, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.35, left=0.07, right=0.96, top=0.90, bottom=0.06)

y = np.arange(n)

def style_ax(ax, title):
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_title(title, color='white', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, labelsize=9)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color(GRID)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=GRID, linewidth=0.5)

# Panel 1: Supply-Demand Ratio
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
vals = [sd_ratio[c] for c in countries]
colors = [stress_color(stress_cls[c]) for c in countries]
bars = ax1.barh(y, vals, color=colors, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax1.axvline(1.0, color='white', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax1.text(1.02, n - 0.3, 'Demand = Supply', color=TEXT, fontsize=8, rotation=90, va='top')
ax1.set_yticks(y)
ax1.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax1.set_xlabel('Supply ÷ Demand Ratio', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals):
    ax1.text(v + 0.08, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax1, 'Water Supply-to-Demand Ratio')
ax1.set_xlim(0, max(vals) * 1.18)

# Panel 2: Per-Capita Freshwater (log scale)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
vals2 = [pc[c] for c in countries]
colors2 = [ACCENT_RED if v < 1000 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v < 1700 else ACCENT_BLUE) for v in vals2]
ax2.barh(y, vals2, color=colors2, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.axvline(1000, color=ACCENT_RED, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.8)
ax2.text(1050, n - 0.3, 'Scarcity\nthreshold\n(1,000 m³)', color=ACCENT_RED, fontsize=7, va='top')
ax2.set_yticks(y)
ax2.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax2.set_xlabel('m³ / person / year (log scale)', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals2):
    label = f'{v:,}'
    ax2.text(v * 1.15, i, label, va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=7.5)
style_ax(ax2, 'Per-Capita Freshwater Availability')

# Panel 3: Groundwater Extraction/Recharge Ratio
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
vals3 = [gw[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries]
colors3 = [ACCENT_RED if v > 1.0 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v > 0.8 else ACCENT_GREEN) for v in vals3]
ax3.barh(y, vals3, color=colors3, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax3.axvline(1.0, color='white', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax3.text(1.05, n - 0.3, 'Overdraft\nthreshold', color=TEXT, fontsize=8, va='top')
ax3.set_yticks(y)
ax3.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax3.set_xlabel('Extraction ÷ Recharge Ratio', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals3):
    ax3.text(v + 0.07, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax3, 'Groundwater Extraction vs. Recharge')
ax3.set_xlim(0, max(vals3) * 1.15)

# Panel 4: Precipitation trend (% change 1990s→2010s)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
vals4 = [precip_change[c] for c in countries]
colors4 = [ACCENT_RED if v < -5 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v < 0 else ACCENT_GREEN) for v in vals4]
ax4.barh(y, vals4, color=colors4, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax4.axvline(0, color='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
ax4.set_yticks(y)
ax4.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax4.set_xlabel('Precipitation Change (%)', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals4):
    offset = 0.3 if v >= 0 else -0.3
    ha = 'left' if v >= 0 else 'right'
    ax4.text(v + offset, i, f'{v:+.1f}%', va='center', ha=ha, color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax4, 'Precipitation Trend (1990s → 2010s)')

# Panel 5: Composite heatmap
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
indicators = ['Supply/Demand\nRatio', 'Per-Capita\nFreshwater', 'Groundwater\nOverdraft', 'Precipitation\nDecline']

# Normalize each indicator 0-1 where 1 = worst
def norm_inv(vals, vmin=None, vmax=None):
    vmin = vmin or min(vals)
    vmax = vmax or max(vals)
    return [1 - (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) for v in vals]

def norm_dir(vals, vmin=None, vmax=None):
    vmin = vmin or min(vals)
    vmax = vmax or max(vals)
    return [(v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) for v in vals]

mat = np.zeros((n, 4))
mat[:, 0] = norm_inv([sd_ratio[c] for c in countries])
mat[:, 1] = norm_inv([pc[c] for c in countries])
mat[:, 2] = norm_dir([gw[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries])
mat[:, 3] = norm_inv([precip_change[c] for c in countries])  # more negative = worse → invert

from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('stress', [ACCENT_GREEN, ACCENT_YELLOW, ACCENT_ORANGE, ACCENT_RED])
im = ax5.imshow(mat, cmap=cmap, aspect='auto', vmin=0, vmax=1)
ax5.set_xticks(range(4))
ax5.set_xticklabels(indicators, fontsize=9)
ax5.set_yticks(y)
ax5.set_yticklabels(countries)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(4):
        ax5.text(j, i, f'{mat[i,j]:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', color='white' if mat[i,j] > 0.5 else 'black', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold')
style_ax(ax5, 'Composite Water Stress Severity (0 = Low, 1 = Critical)')
cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax5, fraction=0.02, pad=0.02)
cb.ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, labelsize=8)
cb.set_label('Severity', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)

# Legend for stress classes
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_RED, label='Extremely High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_ORANGE, label='High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_YELLOW, label='Medium-High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_BLUE, label='Medium'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_GREEN, label='Low')]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=5,
           facecolor=BG, edgecolor=GRID, labelcolor=TEXT, fontsize=9,
           title='WRI Stress Classification', title_fontproperties={'weight': 'bold', 'size': 10})
plt.setp(fig.legends[0].get_title(), color=TEXT)

fig.text(0.98, 0.01, 'Data: FAO AQUASTAT / WRI Aqueduct (2023 est.)', ha='right', color=TEXT, fontsize=7, alpha=0.6)

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor=BG, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Done')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    D = json.load(f)

# Order countries by supply_demand_ratio (most stressed first)
sd = sorted(D['water_supply_demand']['data'], key=lambda x: x['supply_demand_ratio'])
countries = [r['country'] for r in sd]
n = len(countries)

# Build lookup dicts
sd_ratio = {r['country']: r['supply_demand_ratio'] for r in sd}
stress_cls = {r['country']: r['stress_class'] for r in sd}
pc = {r['country']: r['per_capita_m3'] for r in D['per_capita_freshwater']['data']}
gw = {r['country']: r for r in D['groundwater_extraction']['data']}

# Precip trend: % change from 1990s to 2010s
precip_by = {}
for r in D['precipitation_trends']['data']:
    precip_by.setdefault(r['country'], {})[r['decade']] = r['mean_precip_mm']
precip_change = {c: (precip_by[c]['2010s'] - precip_by[c]['1990s']) / precip_by[c]['1990s'] * 100 for c in countries}

# Colors
BG = '#0d1117'
TEXT = '#c9d1d9'
GRID = '#21262d'
ACCENT_RED = '#f85149'
ACCENT_ORANGE = '#d29922'
ACCENT_YELLOW = '#e3b341'
ACCENT_GREEN = '#3fb950'
ACCENT_BLUE = '#58a6ff'

def stress_color(cls):
    return {'Extremely High': ACCENT_RED, 'High': ACCENT_ORANGE, 'Medium-High': ACCENT_YELLOW, 'Medium': ACCENT_BLUE, 'Low': ACCENT_GREEN}[cls]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 13), facecolor=BG)
fig.suptitle('Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison (2023)',
             color='white', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.97)
fig.text(0.5, 0.94, 'Countries ordered by water supply-to-demand ratio (most stressed → least stressed)',
         ha='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=11, fontstyle='italic')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 3, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.35, left=0.07, right=0.96, top=0.90, bottom=0.06)

y = np.arange(n)

def style_ax(ax, title):
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_title(title, color='white', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, labelsize=9)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color(GRID)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=GRID, linewidth=0.5)

# Panel 1: Supply-Demand Ratio
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
vals = [sd_ratio[c] for c in countries]
colors = [stress_color(stress_cls[c]) for c in countries]
bars = ax1.barh(y, vals, color=colors, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax1.axvline(1.0, color='white', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax1.text(1.02, n - 0.3, 'Demand = Supply', color=TEXT, fontsize=8, rotation=90, va='top')
ax1.set_yticks(y)
ax1.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax1.set_xlabel('Supply ÷ Demand Ratio', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals):
    ax1.text(v + 0.08, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax1, 'Water Supply-to-Demand Ratio')
ax1.set_xlim(0, max(vals) * 1.18)

# Panel 2: Per-Capita Freshwater (log scale)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
vals2 = [pc[c] for c in countries]
colors2 = [ACCENT_RED if v < 1000 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v < 1700 else ACCENT_BLUE) for v in vals2]
ax2.barh(y, vals2, color=colors2, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.axvline(1000, color=ACCENT_RED, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.8)
ax2.text(1050, n - 0.3, 'Scarcity\nthreshold\n(1,000 m³)', color=ACCENT_RED, fontsize=7, va='top')
ax2.set_yticks(y)
ax2.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax2.set_xlabel('m³ / person / year (log scale)', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals2):
    label = f'{v:,}'
    ax2.text(v * 1.15, i, label, va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=7.5)
style_ax(ax2, 'Per-Capita Freshwater Availability')

# Panel 3: Groundwater Extraction/Recharge Ratio
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
vals3 = [gw[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries]
colors3 = [ACCENT_RED if v > 1.0 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v > 0.8 else ACCENT_GREEN) for v in vals3]
ax3.barh(y, vals3, color=colors3, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax3.axvline(1.0, color='white', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax3.text(1.05, n - 0.3, 'Overdraft\nthreshold', color=TEXT, fontsize=8, va='top')
ax3.set_yticks(y)
ax3.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax3.set_xlabel('Extraction ÷ Recharge Ratio', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals3):
    ax3.text(v + 0.07, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax3, 'Groundwater Extraction vs. Recharge')
ax3.set_xlim(0, max(vals3) * 1.15)

# Panel 4: Precipitation trend (% change 1990s→2010s)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
vals4 = [precip_change[c] for c in countries]
colors4 = [ACCENT_RED if v < -5 else (ACCENT_ORANGE if v < 0 else ACCENT_GREEN) for v in vals4]
ax4.barh(y, vals4, color=colors4, edgecolor='none', height=0.65)
ax4.axvline(0, color='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
ax4.set_yticks(y)
ax4.set_yticklabels(countries)
ax4.set_xlabel('Precipitation Change (%)', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(vals4):
    offset = 0.3 if v >= 0 else -0.3
    ha = 'left' if v >= 0 else 'right'
    ax4.text(v + offset, i, f'{v:+.1f}%', va='center', ha=ha, color=TEXT, fontsize=8)
style_ax(ax4, 'Precipitation Trend (1990s → 2010s)')

# Panel 5: Composite heatmap
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
indicators = ['Supply/Demand\nRatio', 'Per-Capita\nFreshwater', 'Groundwater\nOverdraft', 'Precipitation\nDecline']

# Normalize each indicator 0-1 where 1 = worst
def norm_inv(vals, vmin=None, vmax=None):
    vmin = vmin or min(vals)
    vmax = vmax or max(vals)
    return [1 - (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) for v in vals]

def norm_dir(vals, vmin=None, vmax=None):
    vmin = vmin or min(vals)
    vmax = vmax or max(vals)
    return [(v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) for v in vals]

mat = np.zeros((n, 4))
mat[:, 0] = norm_inv([sd_ratio[c] for c in countries])
mat[:, 1] = norm_inv([pc[c] for c in countries])
mat[:, 2] = norm_dir([gw[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries])
mat[:, 3] = norm_inv([precip_change[c] for c in countries])  # more negative = worse → invert

from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('stress', [ACCENT_GREEN, ACCENT_YELLOW, ACCENT_ORANGE, ACCENT_RED])
im = ax5.imshow(mat, cmap=cmap, aspect='auto', vmin=0, vmax=1)
ax5.set_xticks(range(4))
ax5.set_xticklabels(indicators, fontsize=9)
ax5.set_yticks(y)
ax5.set_yticklabels(countries)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(4):
        ax5.text(j, i, f'{mat[i,j]:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', color='white' if mat[i,j] > 0.5 else 'black', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold')
style_ax(ax5, 'Composite Water Stress Severity (0 = Low, 1 = Critical)')
cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax5, fraction=0.02, pad=0.02)
cb.ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, labelsize=8)
cb.set_label('Severity', color=TEXT, fontsize=9)

# Legend for stress classes
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_RED, label='Extremely High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_ORANGE, label='High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_YELLOW, label='Medium-High'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_BLUE, label='Medium'),
                   Patch(facecolor=ACCENT_GREEN, label='Low')]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=5,
           facecolor=BG, edgecolor=GRID, labelcolor=TEXT, fontsize=9,
           title='WRI Stress Classification', title_fontproperties={'weight': 'bold', 'size': 10})
plt.setp(fig.legends[0].get_title(), color=TEXT)

fig.text(0.98, 0.01, 'Data: FAO AQUASTAT / WRI Aqueduct (2023 est.)', ha='right', color=TEXT, fontsize=7, alpha=0.6)

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor=BG, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Done')
